agreement.title: C2C Trading Agreement
agreement.loadError: Failed to load the agreement, please retry
agreement.body:
OTC trading agreement (v1-draft, illustrative draft with no legal effect)

1. The platform acts as the OTC counterparty and provides quotes for buying and selling crypto assets. Quotes expire and may change before submission.

2. Orders require the appropriate identity verification level. Payer name and country come from verified KYC information.

3. Per-order, daily and monthly limits apply.

4. Purchases use the payment details shown on the order. Sales lock the corresponding assets for platform review.

5. Submitting an order accepts the displayed agreement version. Users are responsible for checking payment details.
